card.name: Tablet after a count in dosing
card.fires_on: The word tablet or tablets right after a small number such as 1 or 2, in dosage instructions. Often inside parentheses after a mg strength.

modes.label: Count in parentheses
modes.description: Tablet count given in brackets after a strength in mg.
modes.example: TELET tablets at 20 mg (1<< tablet>>) orally once daily.

modes.label: Count in dose instruction
modes.description: Number of tablets stated as the recommended or starting dose.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Adults Recommended dosage: 1<< tablet>> of 85/500

card.plain: It marks the word tablet when it says how many tablets make up a dose.
